local.environment: Local Docker HTTP stack with PostgreSQL; operator-verified API and isolated worker resource caps.

cursor is clamped to selected interval

trajectory uses three projections and signals retain actual SVG paths

late interval response cannot replace newer authoritative metrics
invalid reversed bounds preserve the selected plots and show validation
rapid cursor changes coalesce image loads to the final selected stereo pair
desktop has no horizontal overflow
390px mobile has no horizontal overflow
deep-link reload loads the same private run without browser-persisted run data
leaving investigation discards pending images and private plot DOM
cancelled run exposes an honest unavailable investigation state
other account cannot read investigation artifact
other account cannot read investigation interval metrics
other account cannot read investigation images
session expiry on image request clears images, charts and private run text
anonymous camera access is rejected
no unhandled browser errors
no CSP violations
deployment serves a Content-Security-Policy header
registration creates an authenticated empty private workspace
created project uses a persistent UUID route
project description renders as text rather than HTML
catalog reference coverage is shown independently
no disconnected execution controls exist
project persists across refresh and deep links
project name and description save through backend

editing creates version 2 and exact parameter differences
version 1 retains its exact original specification and hash
saving unchanged fields does not create a version

comparison identifies every changed supported field

expanded immutable specification fits a 390 px viewport
private drafts are not persisted in browser storage
project results never borrow the external qualification run
light theme persists on reload

a second account cannot open the first account project
cross-account GET PATCH DELETE all return 404

real CSRF rejection is displayed with session reload recovery
